# Overview {.unnumbered}

_One 2-hour session_

<!--
:::{.callout-note title="Learning Goals" collapse="false"}
After this lesson, you should be able to:

* YOUR LEARNING GOALS
:::
-->

This workshop introduces a variety of statistical methods and models to account
for missing or censored measurements in datasets. We’ll begin by reviewing
different types of missingness and censorship. We’ll then discuss specific
models and strategies for imputation and estimation, when they’re appropriate,
and when they break down. Extra emphasis will be given to techniques for
working with nondetect (left-censored) measurements.
